verdict.rationale: Time logging is a fair axis for a work-management product like monday.com, but nothing in the evidence pack mentions time tracking, timesheets, or logging hours against items or boards. The docs cover agents, MCP, the GraphQL API, integrations and custom column types; these are building blocks, not a documented time-logging feature, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can log time directly against tasks and projects
